title: Announcing the initial People-First AI Fund grantees
summary: The OpenAI Foundation announces the initial recipients of the People-First AI Fund, awarding $40.5M in unrestricted grants to 208 nonprofits supporting community innovation and opportunity.
body: The OpenAI Foundation announces the initial recipients of the People-First AI Fund, awarding $40.5M in unrestricted grants to 208 nonprofits supporting community innovation and opportunity.
summaryZh: OpenAI基金会宣布了首批“People-First AI Fund”受赠名单，向208家非营利组织提供总计4050万美元的资助。此举主要关注社会公益，与大模型技术本身无直接关联。

aiReview.reasonZh: 属于企业社会责任与慈善捐赠范畴，不涉及大模型技术研发或应用的核心进展。
